messages:
alex: Quick check-in — evening capacity digest. Staging shows 8/10 GPUs healthy after the mid-day burn. Two units still pending. Can owners call out open actions? We need shipment ETA, rack power/FW, network IPs, and PR reviews. Prod canary targeted Tue. Short list: milestones, owners, blockers.

maria: Procurement update — vendor CONFIRMED 2x H100s shipping Tue 03/25, carrier ETA to FRA DC Thu. Tracking SAT-12345. I filed shipment docs in confluence. :package:

kai: Rack power is within planned headroom but two PDUs need firmware (they're on older fw v1.0.3). Eng-infra recommends a brief maint window to apply v1.0.7. Suggest Fri 10-12 UTC. @darren can you coordinate access?

darren: I can do Fri 11-13 UTC if that helps (slightly shifted). I'll sync with on-site techs. Also opened PR #412 for reservation->sku mapping; needs a quick review (small YAML change).

camila: I'll review PR #412 tonight. Quick q: for the Dedicated canary, are we pinning to the quantized variant or testing floating pt first?

alex: Pin canary to `redwood/model-x:v1.4-quant` for latency baseline. Fallback `v1.3` if regressions. We'll note in the runbook.

ops-bot: reservation created: res-20250325-78, capacity=16 GPUs, owner=eng-platform, region=fra-1. Reservation link: https://console.redwood.internal/res/res-20250325-78

maria: Network update: VLAN 3402 allocated but we still need the static IP pool assigned for the cluster. @net-jamie can you allocate the /28 and post the spreadsheet? Link to VLAN: https://internal.net/vlans/3402

net-jamie: Allocated 10.20.34.0/28. Usable .2-.13. I'll post the IP spreadsheet in 30m and add DNS entries. ETA ~30m.

camila: Quick smoke results: `kubectl get nodes` shows 8 Ready, 2 NotReady with `nv_peer_mem` kernel errors. Logs attached in the confluence test run.

eng-infra-bot: NV peer mem issue often indicates driver mismatch. Suggested steps: `modprobe nv_peer_mem` then restart kubelet on affected nodes. If that fails, re-install driver v525.85.12.

maria: Canary plan proposal: day0 deploy to 10% traffic, day1 30%, day2 100% if stable. Auto rollback to CPU-fallback model if error-rate >1% or latency >95th baseline +200ms. Need runbook and SLOs documented.

alex: I'll author the runbook draft tonight and add the traffic ramp/rollback criteria. @sasha can SRE add the kv-cache miss-rate alert and latency alert?

sasha: SRE ack. I'll add an alert: kv-cache miss rate >5% sustained for 5m and 95th latency > baseline +200ms triggers rollback webhook. Also will add runbook link once Alex posts.

camila: Anything blocking on quota or billing? Finance earlier said reservations ok but final approval pending.

finance-bot: PO submitted to vendor (PO-7781). Payment status: pending finance approval. Contact finance@redwood.com for expedited handling.

darren: Action recap (keeping short):
1) Maria follow up on shipment tracking & confirm carrier ETA (maria)
2) Jamie post IP spreadsheet + DNS (net-jamie, in progress)
3) Eng-infra apply driver fix & schedule PDU FW maint (kai + eng-infra-bot)
4) Camila review PR #412 (camila)
5) Alex draft/runbook + post link (alex)
6) SRE add alerts & rollback webhook (sasha)
7) Finance confirm payment approval (finance-bot/finance)

alex: +1 to the list. I'll update this thread when runbook is live and when I pin the canary config in infra. Thanks all :rocket:
